component.name: XML Atlas
component.summary: View and edit large XML files

description.p: XML Atlas opens XML files of hundreds of megabytes in well under a second and shows them as a tree, a grid of the selected element's children, and the source text.
The text can be edited, and tree and grid follow. Files that are not well-formed still open, with their errors listed. Formatting changes only whitespace, and saving keeps every other byte as it was.
